items.statement: Evidence for norDTCO contracts on first oxidation
items.expected: Actual relaxed structures of full norDTCO establish d(S···S,neutral singlet)>d(S···S,radical cation doublet) for a declared comparable local conformational family, with atom mapping and structural uncertainty sufficient to resolve the contraction. The molecular graph and redox state, not an inaccessible source twist geometry, define eligibility. A different justified conformational family is not automatically rejected, but it must actually show this contraction; imposed contacts, averaging unrelated basins without a physical population definition, a charge+1 input, or an unresolved/reversed change do not establish it. No absolute endpoint target or mandatory conformer-search protocol applies. For PR assess the disclosed twist-basin neutral/radical endpoints and their response, or justify a physically comparable substitution; report both distances without author-value windows.

items.statement: Evidence for Final norDTCO first-oxidation bonding account
items.expected: The final norDTCO interpretation combines the computed modest S···S contraction, distributed sulfur spin/oxidation response and orbital evidence into a weak delocalized transannular two-center/three-electron-compatible radical interaction. This is not a conventional closed-shell S–S single bond. A bonding name alone, or sulfur spin without the structural/orbital synthesis, does not pass; no unperformed second oxidation is required.

items.statement: Evidence for Physical origin of the difference between the two framework responses
items.expected: Actual comparable neutral/radical geometries and electronic analyses support the smaller structural relaxation of norDTCO as a consequence of its constrained nortricyclene framework, while both molecules retain a sulfur-pair oxidation response. Use the calculated contraction comparison as evidence for this causal distinction, not as proof of a different integer bond or of absent sulfur interaction. Limit the inference to the characterized conformational basins; no global population or unique quantitative strain decomposition is implied. A fully established physically equivalent explanation passes directly.
